svg.title: The rows and the cursor commit together, or not at all
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “The rows and the cursor commit together, or not at all” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch showing three pagination styles with offset pagination crossed out in red because rows shift between pages; an exponential backoff timeline with marks at one, two, four and eight seconds plus dashed jitter marks; the central idea drawn as one green box containing both the thousand fetched rows and the cursor value 43000 with a single commit arrow leaving it, and the two alternative orderings struck through as causing duplicates or data loss; and a progress bar to a hundred thousand records with a crash marked at forty-three thousand, annotated that resuming took exactly one hundred API calls in total, the same as an uninterrupted run, with matching checksums.
svg.text: The rows and the cursor commit together, or not at all
draw it from memory, then compare
